response.query: What pilot protocol and data are needed to demonstrate achievable fold-enrichment, time-to-result, and contamination controls for a <60-minute on-cartridge enrichment?
response.answer: To demonstrate <60-minute on-cartridge enrichment, pilot protocols should include control samples, contamination checks, and time-to-result measurements. Use validated enrichment methods and compare results against standard controls. Ensure contamination controls are in place to validate accuracy.
